HOLD at RESEARCH, per explicit human decision 2026-08-04. Although the official frozen acceptance framework produced PASS (base EXP-016 + recent-period EXP-017, both PASS, no conflict), the supplementary post-COVID robustness run (EXP-018, additional evidence only, does not alter the Research Verdict) produced REJECT on a high-quality 224-trade sample (evidence quality HIGH, 90.0/100) -- negative out-of-sample expectancy specifically in the most recent structural regime. The strategy also underperformed the existing paper-trading strategy 52-Week High Momentum (SW-003) on every primary performance metric (CAGR, Sharpe, MaxDD, profit factor, win rate, expectancy, at both the base and recent-period horizon). The diversification comparison (genuine sector-exposure divergence from SW-003, see swing_research/strategy_library/cross_sectional_momentum.md) is preserved as real evidence but is judged insufficient on its own to justify paper trading at this stage. May be reconsidered later if additional published strategies (e.g. PEAD) demonstrate complementary behavior that changes the overall portfolio decision. Research Verdict (PASS) is unaffected by this Deployment Status decision -- the two remain fully independent.

DEFERRED -- historical earnings surprise dataset unavailable, per explicit decision 2026-08-05. PEAD (Bernard and Thomas 1989/1990; Foster, Olsen and Shevlin 1984) requires Standardized Unexpected Earnings (SUE) computed from ~8-10 years of quarterly earnings-surprise events per symbol across the 457-symbol frozen universe, to support the standard 2-year validation + 10-year evaluation + recent-period + post-COVID robustness pipeline used for every other strategy. Investigated: (1) fundamentals/fundamental_agent.py -- point-in-time-only snapshot (trailing P/E, ROE, debt/equity), no earnings-surprise or historical time-series capability. (2) yfinance (the only data source integrated anywhere in this program) -- live-tested against real NSE symbols (RELIANCE.NS, TCS.NS): Ticker.earnings_history returns the right FIELDS (epsActual, epsEstimate, epsDifference, surprisePercent) but only ~4 trailing quarters (~1 year); quarterly_income_stmt/quarterly_financials EPS rows are similarly capped at ~5 quarters; Ticker.calendar is forward-looking only (next unannounced earnings date). No analyst-consensus-estimate history exists via any available source. (3) No cached or alternative earnings/fundamentals dataset exists anywhere in this repository. CONCLUSION: faithful implementation is not currently possible -- not a disclosed-assumption situation like every other strategys NSE adaptations, but a hard data-availability ceiling (~1 year available vs ~8-10 years required). Per explicit direction: do not implement using incomplete data, do not reduce the evaluation period, do not substitute a different signal, do not create an approximation that changes the published strategy. No backtest was run; no Research Verdict applies (remains NOT_YET_EVALUATED). REVISIT CONDITION: if a historical earnings/analyst-consensus dataset covering the Nifty 500 for approximately 10 years becomes available (e.g. a paid data vendor, or a dataset the user sources independently), PEAD can be reconsidered under the same frozen research protocol used for every other strategy.

Approved for PAPER_TRADING alongside SW-003 (52-Week High Momentum), 2026-08-05. Paper portfolio allocation: SW-003 60% / SW-008 40%, reflecting the deeper drawdown profile (45.58% vs 30.8%). Paper-trading allocation only -- no production capital allocation changed.
